appraisal_events.evidence: "Vous ne voulez pas venir dîner mercredi avec elle ?" ... "Et samedi ?" ... "vous n'êtes pas un homme facile à avoir chez soi."
appraisal_events.explanation: The hostess repeatedly and solicitously invites the narrator to dine with the duchesse de Guermantes, treating him as worth actively cultivating for her most exclusive company.

status_effects.explanation: He is repeatedly courted for inclusion in an exclusive dinner with the duchesse de Guermantes, marking him as socially desirable company rather than a passive bystander.

ambiguities: The 'Mme de Stermaria' the narrator has a prior dinner engagement with almost certainly refers to Mlle de Stermaria (the young woman), not M. de Stermaria (the candidate list entry, her father); since the candidate list does not include Mlle de Stermaria, no event is scored under M. de Stermaria for this mention.

Duchesse de Guermantes is named only as the desired dinner companion the princesse is arranging around; she performs no action and has no distinct local outcome of her own in this passage, so she was not scored separately from the already-captured hostess movement.
